newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: GOLF-DAD'S ADVICE HELPS TORRANCE TO SIX-STROKE LEAD.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-DAD'S ADVICE HELPS TORRANCE TO SIX-STROKE LEAD.

text.p: Briton Sam Torrance took a six-shot lead at the European Masters on Friday and said his sparkling form was the result of sound paternal advice.

"My dad gave me a lesson at Wentworth on Monday," Torrance said after his eight-under-par second round 63 for a 128 total left the rest trailing. "I hadn't been moving my legs into the swing and everything has now clicked into place."
Torrance, revelling in brilliant sunshine in the Swiss Alps, shot a 65 in the first round with a heavier putter than usual, before reverting to his regular putter on Friday.
"It didn't feel quite right," he said. "So I went back to my usual putter today and took only 27 putts."
Starting at the 10th, he birdied his opening hole then had his only bogey of the day at the short 11th.
He hit birdie fours at the long 14th and 15th holes to turn in 33. Coming home, he shot six birdies for a back nine of 30.
"This was the best I've played for a long time," he said. "These last two days have been better than anything I did last year."
Overnight leader Paul Broadhurst shot 70 for a total of 134.
